alerts.name: [RabbitMQ] File Descriptors Near Limit
alerts.note: The file descriptors are near to the limit
alerts.note_en: The file descriptors are near to the limit
alerts.action:
1) 在节点上执行 rabbitmq-diagnostics status 看 file_descriptors 的 total_used 与 total_limit；
2) 用 rabbitmqctl list_connections 确认连接数是否异常，排查客户端是否未复用连接；
3) 提高上限：改 systemd 的 LimitNOFILE 或容器的 ulimit 后重启节点（RabbitMQ 启动时读取一次）；
4) 同时收敛客户端连接池，避免只靠调高上限。

alerts.name: [RabbitMQ] High Connection Churn
alerts.note: There are a high connection churn
alerts.note_en: There are a high connection churn
alerts.action:
1) 用 rabbitmqctl list_connections peer_host user connected_at 观察哪些客户端在反复重连；
2) 检查客户端是否每次发消息都新建连接——正确做法是长连接复用、每线程一个 channel；
3) 排查是否因心跳超时（heartbeat）或网络抖动导致服务端主动断连；
4) 确认没有触发资源告警（内存/磁盘 watermark）导致连接被阻塞后重连。

alerts.name: [RabbitMQ] Insufficient Established Erlang Distribution Links
alerts.action:
1) 在各节点执行 rabbitmq-diagnostics cluster_status，对比 Running Nodes 找出失联的节点；
2) 检查节点间 4369（epmd）与 25672（distribution）端口的连通性；
3) 确认各节点 Erlang cookie 一致（/var/lib/rabbitmq/.erlang.cookie）；
4) 若已发生分区，按配置的 cluster_partition_handling 策略处理，必要时重启少数派节点让其重新加入。

alerts.name: [RabbitMQ] Low Disk Watermark Predicted
alerts.note: The predicted free disk space in 24 hours from now is low
alerts.note_en: The predicted free disk space in 24 hours from now is low
alerts.action:
1) 用 rabbitmq-diagnostics status 看 disk_free 与 disk_free_limit 的当前值；
2) 用 rabbitmqctl list_queues name messages message_bytes 找出堆积最多的队列，确认是消费者掉线还是消费太慢；
3) 先恢复消费把积压清掉，这是最直接的止血手段；
4) 同时清理该分区上的其他大文件或扩容磁盘，避免真正触发 watermark 阻塞生产。

alerts.name: [RabbitMQ] TCP Sockets Near Limit
alerts.note: The TCP sockets are near to the limit
alerts.note_en: The TCP sockets are near to the limit
alerts.action:
1) 用 rabbitmq-diagnostics status 看 sockets_used 与 sockets_total；
2) 用 rabbitmqctl list_connections 按来源统计，定位连接数异常的客户端；
3) 客户端每次操作都新建连接的，改为长连接 + 多 channel 复用；
4) 确需更多连接时，调大节点的文件句柄上限（socket 上限由它推导）后重启节点。

alerts.name: [RabbitMQ] Unroutable Messages
alerts.note: There were unroutable message within the last 5 minutes in RabbitMQ cluster
alerts.note_en: There were unroutable message within the last 5 minutes in RabbitMQ cluster
alerts.action:
1) 用 rabbitmqctl list_exchanges 与 list_bindings 确认目标 exchange 的绑定关系是否缺失；
2) 核对生产端使用的 routing key 与绑定规则是否匹配（topic 类型注意通配符）；
3) 给 exchange 配置 alternate-exchange，把无法路由的消息兜到备用队列而不是丢弃；
4) 生产端开启 mandatory 标志并处理 Basic.Return，及时发现路由失败。

collect.content:
# As of 3.8.0, RabbitMQ ships with built-in Prometheus & Grafana support.
# Support for Prometheus metric collector ships in the rabbitmq_prometheus plugin.
# The plugin exposes all RabbitMQ metrics on a dedicated TCP port, in Prometheus text format.
#
# enable prometheus plugin:
# `rabbitmq-plugins enable rabbitmq_prometheus`
# `curl http://localhost:15692/metrics`
# 
# then use categraf prometheus plugin scrape http://localhost:15692/metrics instead of this rabbitmq plugin

# # collect interval
# interval = 15

[[instances]]
# # Management Plugin url
# url = "http://localhost:15672"
# username = "guest"
# password = "guest"

## Optional TLS Config
# use_tls = false
# tls_min_version = "1.2"
# tls_ca = "/etc/categraf/ca.pem"
# tls_cert = "/etc/categraf/cert.pem"
# tls_key = "/etc/categraf/key.pem"
## Use TLS but skip chain & host verification
# insecure_skip_verify = true

## Optional request timeouts
##
## ResponseHeaderTimeout, if non-zero, specifies the amount of time to wait
## for a server's response headers after fully writing the request.
# header_timeout = "3s"
##
## client_timeout specifies a time limit for requests made by this client.
## Includes connection time, any redirects, and reading the response body.
# client_timeout = "4s"

## A list of nodes to gather as the rabbitmq_node measurement. If not
## specified, metrics for all nodes are gathered.
# nodes = ["rabbit@node1", "rabbit@node2"]

## A list of exchanges to gather as the rabbitmq_exchange measurement. If not
## specified, metrics for all exchanges are gathered.
# exchanges = ["categraf"]

## Metrics to include and exclude. Globs accepted.
## Note that an empty array for both will include all metrics
## Currently the following metrics are supported: "exchange", "federation", "node", "overview", "queue"
# metric_include = []
# metric_exclude = []

## Queues to include and exclude. Globs accepted.
## Note that an empty array for both will include all queues
# queue_name_include = []
# queue_name_exclude = []

## Federation upstreams to include and exclude specified as an array of glob
## pattern strings.  Federation links can also be limited by the queue and
## exchange filters.
# federation_upstream_include = []
# federation_upstream_exclude = []

# # interval = global.interval * interval_times
# interval_times = 1

# important! use global unique string to specify instance
# labels = { instance="rabbitmq-001" }

# rabbitmq_exporter 插件，在 categraf 内部集成了 kbudde/rabbitmq_exporter 的采集逻辑，
# 走 RabbitMQ Management API（默认 15672 端口），指标名与 kbudde 版 exporter 保持兼容，
# 适合原来就在用独立 rabbitmq_exporter 进程、希望看板和告警规则不改的场景。
#
# 前置条件：RabbitMQ 开启 management 插件
#   rabbitmq-plugins enable rabbitmq_management
#
# rabbit_url 是必填项，保持注释状态时该插件不会启用，填上地址才开始采集。

# # 采集间隔，不配置则沿用 categraf 全局 interval
# interval = 15

[[instances]]
  ## RabbitMQ Management API 地址，必填
  # rabbit_url = "http://127.0.0.1:15672"

  ## Management API 的账号密码，不填默认 guest/guest
  # rabbit_user = "guest"
  # rabbit_pass = "guest"

  ## 连接模式：direct 直连节点，loadbalancer 走负载均衡（前面挂了 LB 时用）
  # rabbit_connection = "direct"

  ## 启用哪些 exporter，默认 exchange、node、overview、queue
  ## 可选：exchange、node、overview、queue、connections、federation、shovel、memory、aliveness
  ## connections、memory、shovel 基数较高，生产环境按需开启
  # enabled_exporters = ["exchange", "node", "overview", "queue"]

  ## 请求超时时间，单位秒，默认 30
  # timeout = 30

  ## 正则过滤，控制采集哪些 exchange / queue / vhost
  # skip_exchanges = "^$"
  # include_exchanges = ".*"
  # skip_queues = "^$"
  # include_queues = ".*"
  # skip_vhost = "^$"
  # include_vhost = ".*"

  ## 队列数超过这个值就跳过队列采集，0 表示不限制，队列特别多时用来兜底
  # max_queues = 0

  ## 排除上游的指标字段，例如 ["messages_ready", "mem_used"]
  # exclude_metrics = []

  ## 请求能力声明，除非确认 RabbitMQ 只接受 JSON，否则保持默认
  # rabbit_capabilities = "no_sort,bert"

  ## aliveness exporter 探测哪个 vhost
  # aliveness_vhost = "/"

  ## Management API 是 https 时按需配置
  # use_tls = false
  # tls_min_version = "1.2"
  # tls_ca = "/etc/categraf/ca.pem"
  # tls_cert = "/etc/categraf/cert.pem"
  # tls_key = "/etc/categraf/key.pem"
  ## 跳过证书链和域名校验
  # insecure_skip_verify = false

  ## 采集间隔 = 全局 interval * interval_times
  # interval_times = 1

  ## 附加标签，多实例时建议用 instance 区分
  # labels = { instance = "rabbitmq-001" }
